mechanism: Use the reference foreground silhouette as a view of class shape. Penalize actual query foreground components whose translation/scale/rotation/reflection-invariant moment descriptors differ from reliable reference components. Optimize complete masks by whole-component deletion and bounded region add/remove/replace moves.
inputs: frozen query features q4096x1024 for spatial proposals
original support/query image height and width
exposure: No query GT, class/fold IDs, additional trained model or encoder invocation. Original image dimensions are observed geometry, not fitted parameters.

shape_descriptor.coordinates: Map canonical grid cells back to normalized original-image coordinates to undo known nonuniform square resizing.
shape_descriptor.moments: Accumulate degree-four raw complex moments for occupied rectangular pixel cells. Three-point tensor-product Gauss quadrature integrates these polynomial cell moments exactly.
shape_descriptor.invariance_scope: Exact similarity/reflection invariance of ideal continuous moments; rasterization, occlusion, perspective and nonrigid deformation can change the observed descriptor.
shape_descriptor.gallery: All four-connected reference foreground components (coverage>0.5) with at least8 cells. No gallery: retain the base.
shape_descriptor.difference: Squared Euclidean distance to the nearest reference signature, converted to bounded debt D/(1+D). Query components below8 cells receive no shape debt because this descriptor is treated as unreliable there.

objective: maximize E(M)=sum_i(base_i-0.5)*M_i - sum_C |C|*shape_debt(C), where C are actual four-connected foreground components of M; strength1.0
steps: Validate aligned query/reference grids and explicitly bound original-image dimensions. Missing geometry retains the base in the core API and is rejected by the batch entry before output creation.
Construct the query spatial feature tree; use its nodes only to supply candidate region moves. Compute moment descriptors and unary sums for all nodes once.
Keep48 eligible region proposals ranked by (unary_sum-area*shape_debt)/sqrt(area), using only inference inputs.
Start from base>0.5. In each of at most4 rounds, remove whole actual foreground components whose component energy is negative; this exactly increases the stated objective.

For each candidate consider adding it, removing it, or replacing touched foreground components with it. Recompute the complete mask's actual connected-component energy, choose one strictly improving move, and repeat within the fixed round budget.
Record every accepted energy change. This finite search is monotone but neither globally optimal nor guaranteed to improve IoU.
Nearest-neighbor expand the final token mask to1024. Save same-nearest base, original bilinear base and bilinear-binary-mask controls.

Run the same search with an ideal generic square silhouette as a strong query-only compactness control. This is a control of one method, not another method count. Seal all predictions before GT scoring.

prediction.conditional: If the reference's global silhouette transfers across same-class instances more reliably than to confusing query regions, the objective can reject a wrongly scored object or accept missing pieces that complete the reference-like shape.
prediction.exact_energy_condition: A proposed complete-mask edit is accepted only if its unary change exceeds its increase in physical-component shape cost; shape-cost reduction can compensate a negative unary change.
proved_or_checked: Continuous descriptor is invariant under translation, rotation, positive uniform scale and reflection
Pixel-cell integration plus original image geometry restores the same ideal square across an anisotropic canonical resize
Removing one pixel without disconnecting a wrong elongated component does not erase its physical shape penalty
Whole negative-energy component deletion and each accepted proposal move increase the stated objective
Zero shape strength preserves the base token threshold exactly
All base values<=0.5 imply an empty solution: nonnegative shape penalties cannot create foreground from entirely nonpositive unary evidence
not_claimed: semantic category identity from shape alone

counterexamples: Viewpoint, articulation, occlusion or contact between multiple instances can alter the true silhouette more than a near-class distractor's silhouette.
Different categories can share these few moment descriptors; matching moments do not establish identity.
Reference connected components can be parts of an object rather than complete instances after coarse rasterization.
Sub-eight-cell query components receive no shape penalty; physically fragmenting an object into tiny components can still evade the prior.
The48 proposal pool and4-round local search can miss the useful edit or get stuck; a true region may also be absent from the feature tree.
There is no recovery when all target-region unary evidence remains negative and the rest of the proposed component cannot pay for it.
Generic compactness may account for an observed improvement; reference-specific value must beat the same-search generic-square control.

cpu_cost.moment_and_proposal_preparation: O(N*11) moment accumulation plus the existing spatial tree; no dense new feature correspondence matrix
cpu_cost.search: At most4 rounds of48 regions x3 moves, each full component/moment evaluation O(N*11) plus small gallery comparisons
cpu_cost.model_resources: Existing cached frozen DINO query features and reference mask only; no new encoder
cpu_cost.synthetic_benchmark: shape_check.json: candidate plus generic-control search on a synthetic64x64x1024 case; excludes actual I/O, graph baseline construction and cohort scoring

checks: shape_check.json: invariant moments, aspect restoration, physical component counterexample, illustrative completion/deletion, monotone energy and zero-strength/no-positive-cue behavior. runner_check.json: two CPU workers, active search, unread GT sentinel and packed1024 outputs.
next_actual_evidence: Bind actual original image H/W and same-producer q/cov/MEAN packets. Compare complete masks against same-readout base and the generic-square search; report class-summed I/U, photo-group paired intervals, true/false additions/deletions and actual timings. User shut down the instance, so no actual cohort run launched.
novelty: unverified; invariant moments, shape priors and local proposal search are established tools
